product.description: Anglia secolului al XV-lea stă sub semnul Războiului celor Două Roze, intre Casa de Lancaster și Casa de York. Icirc;n mijlocul luptelor pentru tron și al intrigilor nesfacirc;rșite, tacirc;nărul Richard al III-lea se indrăgostește de Anne Harrington, care ii devine amantă și ii dăruiește doi copii. Iubirea lor pare eternă, dar Richard, avid după putere și bogăție, se căsătorește cu o altă femeie. Icirc;nsă destinele lor se impletesc din nou, cacirc;țiva ani mai tacirc;rziu, cacirc;nd soția lui moare, iar Richard, incoronat rege intre timp, hotărăște să se intoarcă la prima lui iubire, Anne.

# The Price of Loyalty: The True Love of Richard III by Litera

Discover a dramatic historical romance with *The Price of Loyalty: The True Love of Richard III*. This engrossing novel plunges readers into the tumultuous heart of 15th-century England, where powerful royal houses clashed and personal desires threatened to unravel kingdoms.

## A Tale Set Amidst War and Intrigue

The backdrop is the devastating conflict known as the Wars of the Roses, pitting the Houses of Lancaster against the Houses of York. In this era defined by brutal battles for the throne and vicious political intrigue, we meet Richard IIIâa man whose life becomes intertwined with forbidden passion.

At the center of the drama is his relationship with Anne Harrington. Their burgeoning love story seems destined to be eternal. However, as Richard's ambition grows, fueled by a hunger for power and wealth, he makes choices that challenge everything he holds dear.

### Love vs. Ambition: A Royal Dilemma

The narrative masterfully explores the conflict between duty, passion, and raw political ambition. Despite his commitment to Anne, Richard marries another woman. Fate ensures their paths cross again. Years later, when his first wife passes away, and Richard has already been crowned king, he makes a momentous decision: returning to the love of his life, Anne.

*The Price of Loyalty* is a compelling read that asks readers to consider which forcesâlove, loyalty, or powerâwill ultimately claim victory in the fate of England's royal bloodlines.
